title: Create project layouts from a single-shot prompt
body:
Add single-shot Create Layout: one description, one bounded one-shot provider call, one labeled arrangement preview, then Apply, Save & Apply, or Cancel. Re-running with an edited description replaces the candidate; there is no conversation history. Reuse established arrangement/apply validation.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-16-project-layouts-design.md (sections: Create Layout, Generation boundary)
Blocked by: xbn8qu - Open new Projects with a chosen layout
Dispatch prerequisite: the spec must be committed and available in the worker checkout. This plan only creates Backlog cards; do not start later waves early.
Done when:
- Send only bounded target-Project inventory/labels and description; disclose provider input. No terminal output, chat history, file reading, new Content, or commands.
- Strict provider proposals account for every existing item exactly once and add no new slots, unlike saved layouts. Missing requested Content produces an explanation instead of process/viewer creation.
- A structural change discards the pending request or candidate ("Windows changed - run again"); resize alone does not. Project switch/closure cancels and closes the editor (no resume). One request per Project; re-running supersedes. Caps/timeouts, unavailable providers, and invalid output cannot mutate live arrangements.
- Save & Apply validates and persists before changing live geometry; failures preserve the candidate.
- Test new behavior first, update the feature doc, inspect screenshots of Create/re-run/errors, and verify live Sessions remain usable after Apply/Revert.
Gate: Follow AGENTS.md and the build/validation/change-control references. Run cargo check --target-dir target/agent and cargo test --target-dir target/agent, plus focused behavior tests. GUI claims require inspected screenshots; process preservation requires manager/Inspection evidence.
